scope: future score, baseline, ablation, replay, leakage scan, and verdict producers
required_property: Evidence must be derived from callable computation paths.
admissibility_rule: A score-bearing artifact is not downstream-admissible unless each reported score, baseline, ablation, replay, leakage result, and verdict can be traced to a callable producer with input artifacts and code hash.
failure_path_requirement: At least one relevant failure path must be tested and recorded for every producer class.
